title: Miss Universe 2026: Puerto Rico wins pageant amid ongoing controversy
description:
Miss Puerto Rico has won the 75th Miss Universe pageant. The night wasn’t just about glitz, glam, tears and tiaras. Jennifer Barreto became the first mother and first married woman to win the competition after a rule change three years ago. Over 110 queens from around the world participated. But six Asian nations — Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia and Laos — were banned and visa difficulties forced Nepal and five African countries, including Republic of Congo and South Sudan, to drop out.

BBC culture reporter William Lee Adams joins us to talk about what happened at this year’s competition, including the controversy over Miss Israel’s national costume. Plus we hear from fans in the Philippines, Mexico and the USA about the significance of this years win and beauty pageants overall. Nadeen Ayoub — Miss Palestine 2025 — also discusses the importance of representation.

summaryEn: This episode of What in the World examines the highlights and controversies of the 75th Miss Universe pageant held in Puerto Rico. Miss Puerto Rico, Jennifer Barreto, took the crown, becoming the first married woman and mother to win following a 2023 rule change. The show explores internal power struggles that led to six Asian nations being banned, visa issues that prevented contestants from Nepal and five African countries from attending, and debates surrounding political and religious statements on stage. Additionally, pageant fans and former Miss Palestine Nadeen Ayoub share insights on the importance of national representation.
